title: trifolium subterraneum var. genuinum
intro: Trifolium subterraneum var. genuinum, commonly known as Subterranean Clover, is a perennial legume plant that belongs to the family Fabaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion, due to its high content of isoflavones and other bioactive compounds. The therapeutic actions of Subterranean Clover are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
